page.title: Hifth — revise on the page you memorised

body: our component needs woirk ... there should be a selection seciotn followed on the mistake find ... the mistake mgiht not be a hope ... it might be getting the harah wrong, it might be mis-pronouncing the letter (makharij), it might be getting the tajweed rule  wrong (not doing idgham, etc) ...
